description: Build mcp_registry_ingestor_v2 that reads BOTH remotes[] and packages[] from registry entries (current ingestor only reads packages[], leaving raw_packages='[]' for HTTPS-served MCPs). Populates mcp_registry_facts with proper transport classification (stdio for packages, http/sse/ws for remotes). Idempotent re-run via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. After this lands and re-runs, signal_bridge will have real transport info as a backup data source for Signals 1 and 4.
